purpose: Currentize the already-working Vascular route without rebuilding its anatomy, movement, return fold, retained Hub consequence, or crossing ownership.

canonicalLaw.environmentalRelationship: Stabilize establishes/holds the living-current relationship at the next authored valve.
canonicalLaw.projection: Pulse projects through that held current relationship to confirm the read.
canonicalLaw.rhythm: Beat alignment changes read quality/synchronization gain but never gates permission.
canonicalLaw.absorb: Absorb remains a non-gating local draw-wake expression of the same current.
canonicalLaw.targeting: Aim remains canonical for targetable nouns. The surrounding Vascular current is an environmental relationship and does not invent a noun-target override.

rebind: three route reads from cadence-window timing to Stabilize->Pulse environmental-current relationships
ObjectiveSystem language to canonical current-relationship reads while preserving legacy aliases
telemetry so relationship reads and currentized completion are directly observable
retireAsAuthority: pulse cadence window as progression permission
off-beat button timing as route failure authority

compatibility.lockedCadenceReads: retained as compatibility alias of relationshipReads
compatibility.requiredCadenceReads: retained as compatibility alias of requiredRelationshipReads
compatibility.objectiveAndHistoryConsumers: continue to function without save/history migration

acceptance: Pulse without an established current relationship cannot advance a Vascular read.
Stabilize held near the next authored valve establishes a current relationship.
A fresh Pulse through that held relationship advances exactly one read even outside the legacy beat window.
Beat alignment remains visible and may improve quality, but is not a timing gate.
Three relationship reads plus the existing depth/coherence/settling requirements form the same return current.
Vascular still returns to Hub through LocalCellBoundaryMorphSystem.
No neighboring locked gameplay owner changes.
